description:
Goal
Restore the native selective-receive continuation contract for fixtures2/behavior/receive_selective_refs.fz without weakening continuation ABI invariants.

Reproduction
At integration 6537950bf, `fz2 run` and `fz2 build` panic in native_codegen/terminator.rs because a continuation call has one logical argument but two published parameter representations; `fz2 interp` prints 3. A minimal receive-after-atom followed by arithmetic reproduces. All-integer timeout and no-timeout variants pass. Selecting the atom timeout produces function_clause in the interpreter but the same static native ABI panic.

Proven model
Selective receive transport is sound. The post-receive `+` dispatch legitimately has a numeric returning target and a no-clause target. The returning target publishes one result lane and adapts correctly to the destination entry's result lane plus independent capture. The no-clause target correctly publishes `BackendReturnLayout { reprs: [], diverges: true }` but is sealed as `BackendReturnFlow::Deliver`; native then builds an impossible adapter containing only the capture for a destination requiring result+capture. The callee identity is correct and no carrier was duplicated.

First break
`CallReturnFlow::Deliver` is only a conditional source route: if a selected target returns, resume here. Per-target semantic authority already knows the no-clause target has settled empty/no return. Endpoint publication preserves this as `diverges=true`. `jobs/backend.rs::seal_return_flow` is the first function holding both facts, but unlike Tail it unconditionally seals Deliver even for the divergent source. A sealed per-target `Deliver` plus `source.diverges=true` is contradictory. The interpreter does not consume this sealed per-arm flow; the divergent target halts and never pops the syntactic continuation, explaining interp/native divergence.

Strategy
Refine each per-target flow from its existing settled semantic return authority: returning target remains Deliver; settled-empty divergent target becomes explicit NoReturn. Preserve that fact through backend sealing, where endpoint divergence is an agreement assertion rather than a reconstructed source. Native consumes NoReturn before destination continuation construction and emits the divergent tail call without an adapter. Collapse existing direct/closure divergence special cases onto this one consumer where concordant. Do not infer from repr count: genuine returning zero-value flows remain valid.

Acceptance
Artifact test proves returning arm=Deliver and divergent arm=NoReturn. Backend sealing rejects Deliver+divergent and NoReturn+returning contradictions. Native artifact has no delivery adapter for the divergent arm; its block tail-calls, while the returning arm calls through a continuation and every logical arg count matches published param representations. Minimal numeric and timeout behavior agrees across interp/native. Exact CLI receive fixture passes run/interp/build. Existing go4.10 receive tests, full library, formatting, all-target/all-feature check, and strict clippy remain green. No telemetry compensation, synthetic result, fixture exception, downstream reconstruction, or terminator relaxation.

comments.text: Spike and implementation proof: the receive outcome contract is sound. The post-receive arithmetic dispatch has one returning numeric member and one settled-empty no-matching-clause member. The defect was sealing both as Deliver, which forced native lowering to construct a result continuation for a target that cannot return. The implementation now publishes exact settled-empty targets as NoReturn, verifies local endpoint divergence during backend sealing, rejects NoReturn/Deliver contradictions before NativeProgram, and emits NoReturn as a tail call without an adapter. Shape-Nothing and backend-layout divergence no longer infer Tail; exact direct closure calls share the direct-call flow consumer. Production is net -13 lines excluding tests/docs. Verified: cargo test --lib 1418 passed/0 failed/6 ignored; fz2_cli 19/19; all-target/all-feature check and strict clippy; release original fixture run/interp/AOT all print 3; minimal numeric run/interp print 3; selected timeout reaches function_clause in interp and native.

Audit completion atop a5982c7: the same return-flow loss existed at public-indirect closure calls, the 2+-target fallback, callable boundary publication, and native construction wrappers. Settled CallSiteSummary return evidence is now consumed before result-value lookup: settled empty publishes NoReturn with no local source; settled nonempty still requires and equivalence-checks ActivationAnalysis result authority; a missing summary remains an opaque/unknown call and is not conflated with empty. First-class surface existence now publishes callable boundaries independently of return emptiness; the deleted publish flag/vector and publish_empty_resolved_returns exception had caused all-divergent constructions to be mislabeled direct-only. BackendCallableReturn remains the sole Diverges/Absent/ValueRef authority. Native validates wrapper/member divergence agreement and divergent members share the NoReturn direct tail-call emitter, minting no return adapter; mixed returning members and returning zero-lane Absent members retain Call+adapter. Proof: all-divergent public callable interp reaches function_clause; JIT process exit atom is function_clause and unreachable output is absent; release AOT has no unreachable output. Mixed public callable interp/JIT/AOT prints 2. Existing zero-lane Enum.each remains Absent and prints 1/2/3. Original receive fixture interp/JIT/AOT prints 3. Gates: lib 1427 total/6 ignored green; CLI 19/19; all-target/all-feature check; strict clippy -D warnings; release build and focused artifact/backend/transport/native tests. Production net +42 lines across artifact/native/transport; transport removes 21 net. Disposable spikes removed; two behavior fixtures retained as regression contracts. No fold/close.
